descriptions.en: Unleash a |LENGTH|m destructive beam that inflicts |DAMAGE| Damage/s for |DURATION|s to any target in its path.
descriptions.zh: 释放出 |LENGTH| 米远的毁灭性光束持续 |DURATION| 秒，能对攻击路径中的任何目标造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 的伤害。

descriptions.en: Unleash |COUNT| waves of restorative energy over |DURATION|s, each granting |AMOUNT| Health to allies within |RADIUS|m.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒释放 |COUNT| 波恢复能量，治疗 |RADIUS| 米内的同伴 |AMOUNT| 生命值。

descriptions.en: Release |COUNT| pulses of Void energy over |DURATION|s that suspend and incapacitate enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone for |STASIS|s.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒并释放|COUNT| 次强大的虚空能量脉冲来瘫痪敌人 |STASIS| 秒，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围 |FOV| 度。

descriptions.en: Unleash |COUNT| bursts of psychic energy over |DURATION|s that inflict Confusion on enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone.
descriptions.zh: 持续|DURATION| 秒释放出 |COUNT| 次心灵能量来使敌人进入混乱状态，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围|FOV| 度。

descriptions.en: Unleash a ray of petrifying energy for |DURATION|s that turns enemies into stone for |FREEZE_DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒射出一道石化能量射线，将敌人转化为石头 |FREEZE_DURATION| 秒。
